import os
import pandas as pd
import numpy as np
import lightgbm as lgb
from sklearn.metrics import accuracy_score

# Ensure submission directory exists
os.makedirs("submission", exist_ok=True)

# Load data
train_df = pd.read_csv("./input/train.csv")
test_df = pd.read_csv("./input/test.csv")

# Define target and features
target_col = "Cover_Type"
X_train = train_df.drop(columns=["Id", target_col])
y_train = train_df[target_col]
X_test = test_df.drop(columns=["Id"])
test_ids = test_df["Id"]

# Identify categorical features (Wilderness_Area columns are nominal indicator columns)
categorical_features = [
    col for col in X_train.columns if col.startswith("Wilderness_Area")
]

# Split training data for validation (80/20 split)
train_size = int(len(X_train) * 0.8)
X_train_fold = X_train.iloc[:train_size]
y_train_fold = y_train.iloc[:train_size]
X_val_fold = X_train.iloc[train_size:]
y_val_fold = y_train.iloc[train_size:]

# Define model parameters
params = {
    "objective": "multiclass",
    "num_class": len(y_train_fold.unique()),
    "metric": "multi_logloss",
    "verbose": -1,
    "n_jobs": 4,
    "device_type": "cpu",
    "learning_rate": 0.05,
    "num_leaves": 63,
    "max_depth": 10,
    "min_child_samples": 20,
    "feature_fraction": 0.8,
    "bagging_fraction": 0.8,
}

# Train model with categorical features specified
model = lgb.LGBMClassifier(**params)
model.fit(X_train_fold, y_train_fold, categorical_feature=categorical_features)

# Validate on hold-out set
y_val_pred = model.predict(X_val_fold)
val_accuracy = accuracy_score(y_val_fold, y_val_pred)
print(f"Validation Multi-class Classification Accuracy: {val_accuracy:.6f}")

# Predict on test set
y_test_pred = model.predict(X_test)

# Prepare submission
submission = pd.DataFrame({"Id": test_ids.values, "Cover_Type": y_test_pred})

# Save submission
submission.to_csv("submission/submission.csv", index=False)
print("Submission saved to submission/submission.csv")
